answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake anchored to a secure ledger acts as a stout jetty against Sybil attacks. Rather than relying on a ferrous core of centralized hardware, network validation requires staking native tokens locked in a cryptographic walnut of immutable smart contracts. An attacker attempting to spawn numerous fake identities faces prohibitive capital expenditure, as the protocol slashes staked collateral for malicious coordination, making economic dilution mathematically unprofitable.
